2438-3240-6277-6462.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

116-437-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kiora's Follower is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
116-437-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
116-437-4613.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.

1981-2415-3025-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-3025-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4826-5531-5694-7487-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4826-5531-5694-7487-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Zealous Lorecaster and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
4826-5531-5694-7487-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Zealous Lorecaster and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1545-1594-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-1594-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

1887-3099-4762-7267.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Michelangelo and Vorinclex.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7322.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

851-1558-1671-2638-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-1558-1671-2638-4231.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1402-2438-3593-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

149-2757-3417--143.notablePrerequisites: Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger has indestructible.
149-2757-3417--143.description:
Earthbend a basic land you control.
Cast Legolas's Quick Reflexes by paying {G}, targeting the earthbent land.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the earthbent land, targeting the earthbent land.
The land triggers, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger.
Ill-Tempered Loner // Howlpack Avenger triggers, dealing that much damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Earthcraft trigger, untapping the earthbent land.
Repeat from step 3.
149-2757-3417--143.notes: The {G} in the mana cost can be waived if you earthbend a Forest and tap it for mana before casting Legolas's Quick Reflexes. You may need additional mana to earthbend the land depending on the method of earthbending used.

2034-3875-4826-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

339-677-3480-4050.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

907-5449-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-5449-5702-6664.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1274-2811-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2811-4186.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2645-6410.easyPrerequisites: Howlsquad Heavy does not have summoning sickness.
2645-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least five Goblins.
2645-6410.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-6410.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1912-2060-5140-5640.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Kenrith's ability, targeting any creature you control.
Resolve both Kenrith abilities, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and any creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
1912-2060-5140-5640.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2511-4871-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

When the creature dies, Jackdaw Savior triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning the legendary creature with flying from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Fervent Champion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.

Cast Fervent Champion by paying {R}.
Repeat.

176-3967-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-3967-5522.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

262-2178-4924.notablePrerequisites: Elemental Mastery and Thornbite Staff attached to the same creature with power 1 or greater that does not have summoning sickness.
262-2178-4924.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
The Elemental(s) enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Elemental(s) die, the creature with Thornbite Staff attached triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Repeat.

537-1494-4417.notablePrerequisites: The Grand Evolution has exactly one lore counter on it.
537-1494-4417.description:
At the beginning of your draw step, The Grand Evolution triggers, putting a lore counter on it, then putting five +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing a lore counter from The Grand Evolution and giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat each turn.

Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1} and either {W} or two life.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield, triggering Trostani, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion, causing it to enter the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
